title: tri-sdk-compat-wrappers-and-compact-reauth-shim-v2.3.0
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Backport compact reauth shim and harmonize pullstream ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs. Minor API cleanups and patch version bumps (Py 1.14.2, TS 2.3.0, Go 1.8.1).
description: Motivation: customer teams hit edge cases with token refresh timing when switching transports and observed inconsistent stream resume behavior across SDKs. This PR implements a compact, language-agnostic reauth shim (lightweight credential concierge) and minor ergonomics for pull/pushstream facades so Py/TS/Go exhibit consistent handshake, retry windows, and iterator semantics. Scope: change set touches adapters and surface-level helpers only, avoids changing canonical types used by application code; includes version bumps for parity. Implementation summary: 1) add compact reauth shim module that exposes a thin async/sync facade and a small hook for token priming; 2) normalize iterator close semantics and raise typed errors (AuthError/RetryableAuthError) consistently across SDKs; 3) expose a retry-presets mapping and default jitter profile aligned with Runtime SRE recommendations; 4) update SDK examples and E2E test harness to exercise token rotation mid-stream. Commits: captured below. Files changed: high-level list provided separately. Tests & CI: added unit tests for token windowing and stream resume in all three SDK test suites; flaky test backoff adjusted (see CI notes). Rollout plan: publish patch releases for SDKs and coordinate Docs and Release notes; staged rollout for server-side change is unnecessary because shim is client-side only. Linked work: ENG-2107 tracks the cross-sdk parity matrix; PM-332 is the customer-impact ticket. Migration notes: no breaking changes expected; callers using low-level internal token hooks should be consulted in a follow-up epics. Merge & release: squash-merged and cut patch releases immediately after merge. For details, see commit summaries and review thread below.
